name: What bathroom remodel mistakes cause the most regret?

mainEntity.name: What bathroom remodel mistakes cause the most regret?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common regrets are poor layout decisions, too little storage, cheap waterproofing, bad lighting, and choosing finishes that are hard to maintain. People also regret not planning for ventilation or enough outlets. A good design phase should solve daily-use problems before anyone starts demolition.
